notes.title: Small update!
notes.notes:
Due to popular demand, this update now saves the time you have spent in-between game sessions, so if you need to turn the game off, fear not! For you will no longer lose the progress towards your next hero.

We have also reset the games ability to give promo heroes again, since there are players who haven't received heroes yet. This will now make sure the player has an inventory before trying to give the promo heroes again. If you have already received the heroes, it will not give them again.

Here are the heroes everyone should get.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138530/870da4fa0d438b1540368c3265501f00d5caa866.png[/img]

If you encounter any bugs or have any questions, feel free to reach out to us via discord or the community discussions!

notes.title: Quick Update
notes.notes:
Hello Tuber Connoisseurs!

We fixed a potential error that could have been caused from potatoes clicked to overflow.

This will wipe any existing score before this update, unfortunately, which is why we had to publish this update as quickly as possible!

Thank you!
